title.narrative: BAringo Resilience Initiative: Nurturing Greater Opportunity (BARINGO)

description.narrative: The overall objective of the action is to contribute to improved food, nutrition and income security for 60,000 beneficiaries in Baringo, Kenya. The specific objective of the project is that 10,000 households in Baringo County adopt productive, climate-resilient and nutrition sensitive agriculture and livestock production strategies.
